ten_minute_elapsed_observation.environment: Local disposable database; real non-owner runtime login; two independently supervised workers
ten_minute_elapsed_observation.limitations: Idle query/work counts only; concurrent local activity may affect timings. No hosted capacity claim. Binary bytes are decoded values, not wire traffic.

fixed_pass_comparison.method: Measured SQL counts repeated for an equal number of scheduled passes; baseline wall-clock load was not rerun.

correctness: Real non-owner runtime login: due-work functions expose only bounded organization IDs; table RLS remains enforced.
Rotation preserves progress under a flooded tenant; suspension retains pending intents; worker restart recovers without a wakeup.
Two independent dispatchers competing for the same intent commit one attempt; an injected tenant failure rolls back while another tenant progresses.
Retention locks a bounded set of IDs, skips locked rows, and resumes them later; queued/running calculations and retired history remain intact.
Logical file expiry, quota release, and terminal calculation expiry do not depend on physical cleanup.
Populated forward migration preserves all business rows; full dump/restore retains runtime discovery, RLS, private bytes, receipts and authorized retry behavior.
